known_outcome: The Board varies the decision of the local authority.; It is the determination of the Board that the floor area of the building is required to be barrier-free as described in Section 3.8. of the National Building Code of Canada 1995. The required barrier-free entrance does not require a power door operator. A plumbing system is not required and a barrier-free washroom is not required. A sanitary privy, chemical closet, or other means for the disposal of human waste is required.
